parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results. Do not specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, specify the token returned in the previous request.

parameters.name: ServiceInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service instance.
